scope: Resuming the recorded P02 gap (long library Node/Bun decoding and accumulated tokens/text were UNTESTED). Real public-API inference on the existing 149.7 s fixture with existing local fp32 artifacts and an existing original-engine NeMo reference. No new weights, no tolerance or contract change, no production-feature claim.

fixture.recipe: librivox.org.16k.pcm16.wav mono PCM16 payload concatenated eight times; no resampling, gain or gaps

defect_found_and_fixed.symptom: Got invalid dimensions for input: encoder_outputs for the following indices index: 1 Got: 1872 Expected: 1024
defect_found_and_fixed.root_cause: The encoder-output layout was inferred by comparing axis magnitudes, so a clip with more encoder frames than features flipped it; the decoder then received [1, T, features] instead of [1, features, T].
defect_found_and_fixed.threshold: Audio longer than about 82 s (1024 encoder frames at 10 ms shift with 8x subsampling) fails; the recorded library runs all used an 11 s fixture.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Resolve the layout from the encoder graph own encoded_lengths output, cropping a padded time axis and failing closed when it matches neither axis. The magnitude heuristic remains only for graphs that expose no length output.
defect_found_and_fixed.pre_fix_observed: Node run exited 1 with the ORT dimension error after decoding 1872 frames.
regression_tests: tests/nemo-tdt-executor.test.ts: keeps the feature axis when the encoder returns more frames than features
tests/nemo-tdt-executor.test.ts: fails closed when encoded_lengths matches neither encoder output axis
defect_found_and_fixed.regression_failing_before: Both new tests fail against the previous executor.ts (2 failed / 14 passed) and pass after the fix (16 passed).

limits: Native CPU fp32 library path only. WASM and WebGPU long-form decoding remain UNTESTED.
One fixture and one adapter configuration; no streaming/realtime controller evidence on this length.

This does not change the deferred production-feature gate: library features still differ from the official engine at 313/140,928 JFK coordinates. These runs show that the difference does not change decoding decisions on this fixture, not that the gate passed.
Preprocess and decode timings are from a single run each and are not benchmarks.
